notes.title: Major Update: Survive and Score out now!
notes.content:
[h2][i]Welcome back Star Knights![/i][/h2]

The Survive and Score update is here, with new content including an Endless Mode (which features its own unique mechanics) and a scoring system accompanied with leaderboards which allow you to compare yourself to previous runs and other players. Furthermore, this update introduces many smaller features, improvements, and bugfixes.

[b]Important note:[/b] This update [b]IS[/b] compatible with older saves, so any progress will be kept.

[b][h1]MAIN FEATURES[/h1][/b]

[h3]Scoring System[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44211301/4f9fc5fdf98b38efe1a892a8b46173fd4206c95b.gif[/img]

The scoring system is simple but effective. Players gain points for killing enemies, with a kill streak that increases with every kill and makes each subsequent enemy worth more points. However the killstreak resets if the player takes damage. This makes killing enemies and avoiding damage both important to getting a high score. Furthermore, playing on higher void crystals multiplies the score, meaning the best way to get the highest score is the play at the highest difficulty.

[h3]Leaderboards[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44211301/2dc714a8a6c20b4edfa1ab156adcbce0812c2016.png[/img]

The personal leaderboard shows all of your runs while the online leaderboard shows the best runs from each player. Each run on the leaderboard shows various details such as what ship, attachments, and crew members were used during the run.

[h3]Endless Mode[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44211301/5e03642d063fb6dc9d6a17d28c14f7b7f619976c.png[/img]

When a player wins a run, they have the option to finish the run like normal, or continue back from the beginning in a New Game Plus mode. When you begin New Game Plus, you start back from the beginning of the run with some drastic changes: 

[list]
[*] Greatly increased enemy stats - they are tougher to kill, faster, and hit harder
[*] Increased amount of enemies and less time between waves
[*] Credits are worth more - allowing for continued upgrade progression
[*] Only one new attachment slot per new game plus
[/list]

Furthermore, when in endless mode, upgrades don't just stop at max level anymore. When an attachment hits max level, it can be continuously be upgraded forever, though at costs that get higher and higher. Be aware, the pace of upgrades do not match the pace of the difficulty increase, and death is inevitable.

Also introduced is the Curse mechanic. Rather than earning Relics, each time you defeat a boss you must choose a Curse which increases the difficulty in unique ways such as taking damage whenever you collect a credit or adding more enemies per wave.

[b][h1]OTHER IMPROVEMENTS[/h1][/b]

[h3]Added:[/h3]
[list]
[*] UI addition when getting an attachment synergy
[*] Level transition animation
[*] 16 Curses
[*] Finish run button
[*] Game auto pauses if alt-tabbed
[*] Game no longer interactable if game not in focus
[*] New explosion sounds for boss deaths
[/list]
[h3]Changed:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved level end UI - shows more information and looks better
[*] Improved tutorial - Explains the scoring system along with a few other smaller changes
[*] Improved Challenge Level text effect
[*] Pause Menu UI Overhaul
[list]
[*] Color-coded and better organized stats
[*] Reorganized UI elements to fit better and look better
[/list][*] Relic reroll increases with each reroll
[*] Minor UI improvements in settings menu
[*] Minor UI improvements to Codex
[*] 4th Area boss
[list]
[*] Boss health increased slightly
[*] Shield heal amount: 500 -> 750
[*] Shield goes away if Warships are destroyed
[/list][*] Increased base speed of all ships
[*] Decreased speed bonus from speed booster attachment
[*] Shotgun:
[list]
[*] Doubled firerate and halved damage
[*] Slightly increased shot speed
[/list][*] Relics:
[list]
[*] Retaliation now has a 33% chance
[*] Clean slate now has a 33% chance
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]Fixed:[/h3]
[*] Fixed incorrect text displayed for “Kill x enemies” challenge
[*] Cursor disappearing after pause when choosing an item
[*] Skipping relic choice by pressing enter
[*] Enhanced Engines Relic now increases speed at the correct amount
[*] Added correct relic shaders in End State
[*] Enemy contact damage is affected by damage multiplier
[*] AOE speed affected by screen size
[*] Sizing issues of some text/buttons on different resolutions
[*] Vampire no longer ticks down health when boss death animation is playing

notes.title: Survive & Score - Beta Branch Update
notes.content:
[i][h1]Welcome back Star Knights![/h1][/i]

I'm excited to announce that the Survive & Score update is finally available in the beta stage for anyone who wants to play and test the new content. Since this is still in beta, there will be bugs and balance issues that will need to be fixed.

If you are interested in playing the new update, but don't know how to access the beta branch, check out this link here:

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2462090/view/7374170303759278373

Here are the main additions that are available as part of this beta update:

[list]
[*] [b]Scoring System:[/b] Add a way for players to earn a score that rewards skillful gameplay, giving players another goal to strive for besides just beating a run. Killing enemies adds to a kill streak which makes subsequent kills worth more points. However, taking damage resets the killstreak which makes killing enemies and avoiding damage equally important to getting a high score.

[*] [b]Leaderboards:[/b] Both a personal leaderboard to keep track of personal bests and good runs, as well as an online leaderboard to compete against other players for the highest score.

[*] [b]Endless mode:[/b] Includes an option to keep playing, even after winning a run, and gives players a chance to see just how far their build can go against ever increasing difficulty. Attachment upgrades also continue endlessly, allowing for continuous improvements.

[*] [b]Curses:[/b] In Endless mode, rather than gaining [i]relics[/i], the player now gains [i]curses[/i]. Each curse has its own unique ability to make the game harder such as taking damage when collecting credits or adding more enemies to each wave.
[/list]

[h2]Feedback[/h2]

I 100% welcome any and all feedback, but there are a few things I am looking for in particular.

[list]
[*] How does the scoring system feel? is it satisfying, does the kill streak system make sense? 

[*] Is the leaderboard system intuitive? What additions would you want to see to the leaderboards?

[*] Do the endless attachments work as a good way to spend credits to continuously improving your build while not outpacing the difficulty increases of endless mode?

[*] Do the Curses work as a good way to incorporate player choice into increasing difficulty, as well as providing unique ways to make the game harder besides enemy stat increases.

[*] Endless mode should feel like a fun addition, and not a way to make the game keep dragging on. For that reason, each New Game Plus should feel like significant change and provide a steep difficulty increase. The difficulty of each New Game Plus should be something like this:

[list]
[*] [b]Barely winning a run:[/b] New Game + should destroy you
[*] [b]Handily winning a run:[/b] May be able to beat New Game +
[*] [b]Broken Build and skilled:[/b] May be able to beat New Game +2
[*] If anyone can beat New Game +3 you deserve some sort of award
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Note:[/b] If I do make changes to the scoring system, I will most likely reset the leaderboard before releasing the update, to make sure everyone is on the same playing field. I may also need to reset the leaderboard during beta testing in case I make changes to how the leaderboard works.

And of course, if you are interested in testing and want to provide feedback or report bugs, make sure to join the Star Knight [url=https://discord.gg/gCJ8e2HJFe]discord![/url]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

I'll end this announcement with a patch notes of changes since the most recent devlog:

[h3]Added[/h3]
[*] 16 Curses
[*] Finish run button
[*] Brutal rule changes at New Game Plus 2 and 3
[*] Game auto pauses if alt-tabbed
[*] Game no longer interactable if game not in focus

[h3]Changed[/h3]
[*] Endless mode unlocked at Void Crystal 7
[list]
[*] To not overwhelm new players
[*] To allow for balancing Endless Mode for higher difficulties
[/list][*] Relic reroll increases with each reroll
[*] Minor UI improvements in settings menu
[*] Minor UI improvements to Codex
[*] 4th Area boss
[list]
[*] Boss health increased slightly
[*] Shield heal amount: 500 -> 750
[*] Shield goes away if Warships are destroyed
[/list]
[h2]Fixed[/h2]
[*] Endless upgrades multiplying when continuing a run
[*] Cursor disappearing after pause when choosing an item
[*] Skipping relic choice by pressing enter
[*] Issues when no name is inputted to the leaderboard
[*] Enhanced Engines Relic now increases speed at the correct amount
[*] Asteroid health now scales with New Game Plus
[*] Added correct relic shaders in End State
[*] Enemy contact damage is affected by damage multiplier
[*] Thruster sprite in transition animation correctly scales to screen size
[*] AOE speed affected by screen size
[*] Sizing issues of some text/buttons on different resolutions
[*] Online leaderboard now appears even if player has not uploaded a score

notes.title: Devlog - Leaderboards and Endless Mode

[list]
[*] [b]Scoring System:[/b] Add a way for players to earn a score that rewards skillful gameplay, giving players another goal to strive for besides just beating a run.

[*] [b]Leaderboards:[/b] Both a personal leaderboard to keep track of personal bests and good runs, as well as an online leaderboard to compete against other players for the highest score.

[*] [b]Endless mode:[/b] Include an option to keep playing, even after winning a run, and give players a chance to see just how far their build can go against ever increasing difficulty.
[/list]

[h2]The work so far[/h2]

[h3]Scoring System[/h3]

Furthermore, playing on higher void crystals multiplies the score, meaning the best way to get the highest score is the play at the highest difficulty.

[h3]Leaderboards[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44211301/2dc714a8a6c20b4edfa1ab156adcbce0812c2016.png[/img]

Currently, the personal leaderboard and online leaderboard each show the top 10 scores. Each run on the leaderboard shows various details such as what ship and crew members were used during the run. In the future, I want to add more options to sort against, such as showing top scores earned in a normal run vs an endless run.

[h3]Endless Mode[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44211301/5e03642d063fb6dc9d6a17d28c14f7b7f619976c.png[/img]

When a player wins a run, they have the option to finish the run like normal, or continue back from the beginning in a New Game Plus mode. When you begin New Game Plus, you start back from the beginning of the runs with some drastic changes:

[list]
[*] Greatly increased enemy stats - they are tougher to kill, faster, and hit harder
[*] Increased amount of enemies and less time between waves

[*] Only one new attachment slot per new game play

Furthermore, when in endless mode, upgrades don't just stop at max level anymore. When an attachment hits max level, it can be continuously be upgraded forever, though at costs that get higher and higher. However, the pace of upgrades do not match the pace of the difficulty increase, and death is inevitable.

[h3]Other improvements[/h3]

While the features mentioned above have made up the bulk of the progress, there have been many other additions and changes to the game. These include:

notes.title: Major Update: Blackstar Castle out now!
notes.content:
[h2][i]Welcome back Star Knights![/i][/h2]

The Blackstar Castle update is here, with new content including a brand new area, attachments, relics, crew members, ships, mechanics, and various improvements and bugfixes. 

[b]Important note:[/b] This update [b]IS[/b] compatible with older saves, so any progress will be kept.

[b][h1]MAIN FEATURES[/h1][/b]

[h2]Fight through a corrupted fortress[/h2]
A new area, Blackstar castle, has been added with includes a new boss, new enemies, and new challenge levels. The enemies in this area follow different spawning and combat rules, adding extra variety to the run. 

[b]Blackstar Castle:[/b] A 4th, new area in the furthest reaches of the Vortex
[list]
[*] 6 new enemies to defeat
[*] A new multistage boss
[*] A new challenge level
[*] 2 new music tracks[/list]
[h2]Master an improved arsenal[/h2]
A new attachment class, Volatile, has been added along with 5 new attachments. A new ship, 2 new crew members, and 35 new relics have been added, greatly increasing build potential.

[b]An expanded Order:[/b] New content to outfit your starfighter
[list]
[*] 2 new crew members
[*] A new ship: The Shortsword
[*] New attachment class: Volatile
[*] 5 New attachments
[*] 35 new relics
[*] 3rd Synergy Level for all classes
[/list]
[h2]Overcome the power of an ancient force[/h2]
The Void Crystal ascension system has been completely reworked. The drawbacks and buffs have been changed to curses and blessings, with further Void Crystals having more curses. While early crystals remain relatively unchanged, allowing for new players to ease into and learn the game, later crystals are now much harder, adding a challenge for even the best players.

[b]Void Crystal Ascensions:[/b] Greatly increased the difficulty and challenge of mid to late void crystals
[list]
[*] Added new curses to 10 Void Crystals
[*] Most Void Crystals now have 2 curses
[*] Last 2 Void Crystals now have 3 curses
[*] Total of 12 new curses
[*] Rebalanced existing blessings and curses for a better difficulty curve
[/list]
[b][h1]OTHER ADDITIONS AND CHANGES[/h1][/b]

[b]Game:[/b] Core game systems have been changed or reworked
[list]
[*] Increased base movement speed by 15%
[*] Ability to restart save file
[*] Levels per area decreased from 6 to 5
[*] Enemy health decreased roughly 15% to compensate for less levels
[*] Synergies:
[list]
[*] 2nd Repair synergy decreased from 5 -> 3 extra health
[*] 2nd Summoner synergy decreased from 33% -> 25% damage
[/list][*] Shop attachment chance rework
[list]
[*] Already owned attachments are now weighted based on affordability
[*] Unaffordable upgrades are less likely to appear
[*] Affordable upgrades are more likely to appear
[*] Extremely affordable upgrades are very likely to appear
[/list][*] Massively buffed contact damage to enemies
[list]
[*] Base contact damage increased from 100 to 500
[*] Battering ram contact damage: 1000
[*] Serpent contact  damage: 250
[*] Dinghy contact damage: 1
[/list][*] New additions to the Codex
[*] Changed intro text crawl
[*] Added time left for powerups is displayed on top right
[*] Added stagger and sound effect to end level stats
[*] Increased rate at which kill X enemies challenge level scales per area
[/list]
[b]Enemies[/b]: Various balance changes and additions to existing enemies
[list]
[*] Extra attacks for two demon enemies
[*] Demon Realm enemies drop +2 credits
[*] Increased Swarm launcher health: 600 -> 800
[*] Decreased Swarm Spitter health: 850 -> 600
[*] Later demon enemies health increased
[*] Demon boss health increased
[/list]
[b]Attachments:[/b] Many attachments have had balance changes or complete reworks
[list]
[*] Seeker Dart:
[list]
[*] Alt upgrade path adds Volatile class
[/list][*] Trishot:
[list]
[*] Alt upgrade path adds Volatile class
[/list][*] Credit Locator:
[list]
[*] Base spawn rate increased 12s -> 15s
[*] Alt path: No longer AOE
[*] Alt path: Time between credits increased
[*] Alt path: Credit value increased 1 -> 2
[/list][*] Collector Drone: 
[list]
[*] Base chance decreased 25% -> 15%
[/list][*] Speed Booster: 
[list]
[*] Decreased how quickly speed and firerate increase
[/list][*] Energy Rings:
[list]
[*] Rather than spinning rings, is now an aura around the player
[*] Alt path reduces enemy contact damage
[*] Useful for aggressive playstyles or enemies that get too close
[/list][*] Levy Fighters:
[list]
[*] Decreased base stat boost: 5% -> 3%
[*] Decreased how quickly stat boost increases
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Crew Members:[/b] Some crew members have been tweaked
[list]
[*] Rebalanced unlock requirements of some crew
[list]
[*] Arms Dealer: 300 -> 500 credits
[*] Vampire: 400 -> 500 kills
[*] Pacifist: 2000 -> 2500 total kills
[*] Collector: 8 -> 9 relics
[*] Lone Wolf: Void Crystal 3 -> 7
[/list][*] Knight now doubles shield strength
[/list]
[b]Settings:[/b] New settings allowing for greater customization of your gameplay experience
[list]
[*] Add outline to player ship
[*] Turn off the background stars
[*] Turn off the background spacedust
[/list]
[b]UI/UX[/b]
[list]
[*] Pause Menu
[list]
[*] Added more info on player and game stats
[*] information is now tabbed/organized
[/list][*] Shop
[list]
[*] Sell button now displays how many credits
[/list]
[/list]
[b][h1]FIXES[/h1][/b]
[*] Healing Aura not giving Merchant synergy for alt path
[*] Poison dart not affected by poison damage multiplier
[*] Updated various incorrect/outdated codex info
[*] Text appearing too small in the pause menu
[*] Crew is no longer reset when changing ships or void crystal
[*] Issues that appeared if enemy firerate was too high
[*] Corrected burst spitter firerate from 1s -> 2s
[*] Contact damage is now shown
[*] Bug with Speed Booster that increased firerate much more than expected
[*] Fixed typos in some attachment descriptions

notes.title: Blackstar Castle Update - Releases April 11th
notes.content:
[h2][i]Welcome back Star Knights![/i][/h2]

I'm very excited to be able to share that the release date for the Blackstar Castle update is April 11th 2025. It's been a long way since the Early Access release so this announcement will be also go over all the new content and changes to expect with this update. While there have been a couple of minor updates in the past, this is the first major step outlined in the roadmap. A more detailed patch notes will come with the update's release.

[h3]Fight through a corrupted fortress[/h3]
A new area, Blackstar castle, has been added with includes a new boss, new enemies, and new challenge levels. The enemies in this area follow different spawning and combat rules, adding extra variety to the run. Prepare to learn new attacks and face new foes as you traverse the old headquarters of the Order. The former Grandmaster of the Vortex awaits you...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44211301/f13e8b71bc2aeff45d0b94e300fe327ae87a5748.gif[/img]
[i]A squadron of enemy fighters fly in formation[/i]


[h3]Master an improved arsenal[/h3]
A new attachment class, Volatile, has been added. This class is built around critical hits, allowing for massive damage. 5 new attachments have been added, and a couple of previous attachments have had their alt paths changed to upgrade into Volatile attachments. Furthermore, almost every attachment has been changed or rebalanced in some way, from balance tweaks to complete mechanical overhauls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44211301/34b847d84ce73434eb869a99f927f9856bafdc6e.gif[/img]
[i]A new Volatile attachment slings an asteroid at an enemy and scores a high damage critical hit[/i]


[h3]Overcome the power of an ancient force[/h3]
The Void Crystal ascension system has been completely reworked. Through playtesting and feedback, one of the major issues that has come up is the lack of substantial difficulty increase as players progress through the Void Crystals. The drawbacks and buffs have been changed to curses and blessings, with further Void Crystals having more curses. While early crystals remain relatively unchanged, allowing for new players to ease into and learn the game, later crystals are now much harder, adding a challenge for even the best players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44211301/a8be575587c6c5709eece08a1c66a8b41f27624f.gif[/img]
[i]Some of the reworked Void Crystals[/i]


[h3]Create powerful new builds[/h3]
With this update comes a new ship, the Shortsword, and two new Crew Members, the Priest and Technician. Previous crew members have also been rebalanced or changed, with some gaining more unique abilities. The amount of relics has increased from 60 to 95 with 15 common, 15 rare, and 5 legendary relics added. These new additions allow for a wider range of build opportunities and new ways to play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44211301/6b5a81461b23d52934653020c3879a693927b173.gif[/img]
[i]A handful of available relics[/i]


[h3]Enjoy a number of improvements[/h3]
This update brings dozens of smaller improvements and additions, such as a third tier of attachment synergies, new music tracks, economy rebalances to make it easier to get more credits in later areas, rebalances to enemies and bosses (including new attacks), and more. Not to mention a host of bugfixes and optimizations to make playing a more fun and smooth experience. 

[b]A complete changelog will be released with the Blackstar Castle update on April 11th.[/b]

notes.title: Blackstar Castle - Beta Branch Update
notes.content:
[i][h1]Welcome back Star Knights![/h1][/i]

Some exciting news today for everyone who has been wanting to get their hands on the new update. The Blackstar Castle update is finally available in the beta stage for anyone who wants to play and test the new content. Of course, since this is still in the beta stage, there are likely to be bugs and balance issues that will need to be hammered out, so if you want to experience the new content at its best, it might be better to wait until the full update release. 

If you are interested in playing the new update early, but don't know how to access the beta branch, check out this link here:

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2462090/view/7374170303759278373

And of course, if you are interested in testing and want to provide feedback or report bugs, make sure to join the Star Knight discord! When you open the game, there is a link to the discord on the lower right corner of the main menu.

Besides being a beta announcement, I also want to give everyone a devlog of what's changed since the most recent Steam devlog in January, which you can read here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2462090/view/512946415975007356

One of the changes that comes with this update is the ability to reset your save file. Since pretty much every aspect of the game has been changed since the last update, I added the ability to start a fresh save for those who have already beaten the game and want to check out all the new progression from scratch. To start a new save, go to the Codex tab in the main menu, go to the Stats tab in the Codex, and click on the New Save button on the bottom left. For any beta testers, this would also be extremely helpful to test the balancing of the new progression, particularly the difficulty.

notes.title: Development Update #2
notes.content:
[i][h1]Welcome back Star Knights![/h1][/i]

This update adds the first new in-game content since release and aims to address some of the concerns regarding lack of visual variety, boring enemy behavior, and uninteresting asteroid mechanics. It also adds new challenge levels and brings along some bug fixes, balance changes, and UI improvements.

This is likely the last update before the next major content update which will add a new stage with its own boss and enemies, new items, attachments, crew members, and more. This next major update is currently in progress and should release later this year or early next year.

Asteroids are now destructible! They spawn a bit more frequently, have increasing health throughout a run, and tie in to one of the new challenge levels. Visuals have gotten an update, with a new dash animation, new pixel art sprites for increased background variety, and unique visuals for some challenge levels. Speaking of challenge levels, there are two new ones (Asteroid Field and Astral Storm) along with a change that prevents getting the same one in a row. Enemy spawn behavior has been changed slightly to make it a bit more interesting. Check out the full changelog for all of the updates, changes, and fixes.

notes.title: Beta Branch - Vulture Hotfix
notes.content:
Made some changes to how the Vulture's Active Camo ability works. It now doesn't start recharging until the ability ends, preventing the player from getting the cooldown so low that they can stay in Active Camo indefinitely. It also shows how much time is left in Active Camo, giving more info to the player on how long they have left. Since the recharge doesn't start until the ability ends, I increased the time spent in active camo from 2 to 3 seconds.

notes.content:
[i][h2]Welcome back Star Knights![/h2][/i]

Another update to the beta branch has arrived, with many fixes, balance changes, and some overhauls to existing features. Thank you to all of the beta-testers and if you want to help test upcoming content, you can opt-in to the beta branch by following the steps here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2462090/view/7374170303759278373]Beta Branch Creation[/url]

[i]Warning: [/i]If you have already opted into the beta and have a currently saved run using the mid-run save feature, you will have to start a new run as the changes/fixes to the mid-run save system are not compatible with older run files.

[h2]Full Changelog[/h2]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Slightly reduced opacity of enemy hit flash
[*] Enemy spawn speed increased*
[*] Time for next wave after current wave is cleared decreased**
[*] Crew members in Codex show unlock requirement even after being unlocked
[*] Changed color of summoner bullets
[*] Nerfed Levy Fighter upgrades (particularly in terms of damage)
[*] Slightly buffed Heavy Fighter enemy attack pattern
[*] Large Collector Drone overhaul***
[/list]
[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Memory leak fixes
[*] Can’t accidentally click on void crystal when choosing crew or ship
[*] Save system correctly handles number of levels
[*] Save system correctly handles total credits collected
[*] Save system correctly handles damage taken
[*] Save system correctly displays unlocks
[*] Health gained from Genomancer no longer carries over to other runs
[*] Fixed “Quick Repair” relic bug that allowed repeated healing by just pressing space instead of dashing
[*] Reduced credits granted for Cash Pack Relics
[list]
[*] I) 25 -> 20
[*] 2) 50 -> 30
[*] 3) 75 -> 50
[/list]
[/list]* This does not increase enemy overall speed, just the speed from when they spawn to when they reach their furthest left location. This should make the gameplay feel a bit faster without increasing difficulty.

** This does not increase the general speed at which waves spawn, it only decreases the amount of downtime between the next wave after a wave has been fully cleared. This should make the gameplay feel a bit faster by removing these periods of waiting without increasing difficulty. 

*** Collector Drone now works much differently. Its base speed and detection radius have been greatly increased, removing the need to "babysit" it for the first couple of levels and making it much easier to use. It now has a credit pull radius equal to that of the player, meaning it benefits from any credit pull radius upgrades/buffs and has a much easier time collecting credits (no more instances of watching a credit just barely slip by the drone). The biggest change is that the Drone no longer has a guaranteed chance to add an extra credit. Instead it is based on chance, starting at a 25% chance at level 1 and increasing through various upgrades. This makes the Drone a bit more of a gamble, especially at lower levels, and helps mitigate the problem of completely ballooning with credits.

notes.title: Beta Branch Update #1
notes.content:
[h2][i]Welcome back Star Knights![/i][/h2]

Star Knight: Order of the Vortex now has a beta branch you can opt into to test upcoming changes. This will allow me to test updates and make sure everything is working before adding them to the main branch. If you want to help test upcoming content and patches before they go live on the main branch, right click on Star Knight in your library, select properties -> betas, select the dropdown next to beta participation, and select the beta branch. The Star Knight application in your library will update and appear with [beta] next to the name.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44211301/4b71ac06b4d0c7d1ddeea2416d63d734ff0ad576.png[/img]

Now for the meat of the update. The beta branch includes a host of fixes and changes, as well as a brand new mid-run save system that will save your progress within a run. Now if you need to leave in the middle of a run or you run into an issue that causes your game to crash, that amazing run you had going will not be lost. 

There are some known issues/exploits with the system as it stands and I will be improving it based on feedback and other issues found by betatesters. Known issues include:
[list]
[*]Since the game loads you before the start for the current level, players can save and quit before dying, allowing them to restart the level
[*]Since the attachment options in a shop are not saved, players can quit and reload in as a way to get free rerolls
[*]If a player saves and quits a challenge level, when they load in, the level will no longer be a challenge level
[/list]

[h2]Full Changelog[/h2][h3]Added:[/h3]
[list]
[*]mid-run save system

[*] Reduced speed increase of Speed Booster
[*] Reduced health increase of Hull Booster

[*] Serpent Shield increased 15 -> 25
[*] Improved Vulture and Tempest ability descriptions
[*] Genomancer now gives +5 max health per level
[*] Reduced Healing Synergy from 50% -> 25%
[/list][h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Shielder text now properly displays shield amount*
[*] Collector Drone alt path now gives Gun Synergy
[*] Medic Module alt path now gives Gun Synergy
[/list]

*The change and fix to the shielder may cause some confusion. The amount displayed by the shielder in the past was "+ 20" when it should have been "+ 200". This has been fixed along with a reduction in shield strength from 200 -> 100. So you will see the amount of shield go from "+ 20" to "+ 100". Know that this is a 2X reduction and not a 5X increase.

notes.title: Steam Playtest and Demo Update
notes.content:
Welcome back Star Knights!

It's been awhile since I've made a steam update (Head to the [url=https://discord.gg/PckQRYC3]discord[/url] if you want to see regular updates and devlogs). However, I'm happy to announce that the Steam Playtest for the Early Access release will start on Friday, June 14th. You will need to opt in on the store page and the playtest will run until Friday, June 28th. Be sure to join the Discord and join the playtester community in order to provide feedback and earn yourself a spot in the credits.

I've also made a massive update to the Demo, bringing it up to date with all the new UI, art, sound, and quality of life improvements. Lots of new content has been added (with some being removed to keep the demo just a demo). Be sure to check it out! Just be aware, it is not save compatible with previous demo saves and may cause your controls to be a bit wonky so check the settings to make sure everything is correct.

That's all for now, so make sure to check out the updated demo and get ready for the upcoming Steam Playtest!

notes.title: Star Knight: Weekly Devlog 2
notes.content:
Welcome back Star Knights!

As promised, here is this weeks Friday devlog.  This week has really focused on rebalancing/polishing and overhauling smaller aspects of the game. The most notable change is probably the complete tutorial overhaul. What used to be floating text in space telling you what to do is now an "in-universe" tutorial as the Grandmaster of the Order tests your piloting skills. I also changed how freezing works. Rather than immediately freezing any enemy, hitting an enemy with a cryo shot now applies a stack of freeze. stronger enemies (particularly in later areas) and bosses have a freeze resistance, which require more stacks of freeze to be applied before they are frozen. This was necessary as late game cryo shots were extremely OP since you could just immediately freeze every enemy. 

[i]
[list]
[*]Tempest (Ship): Ability Cooldown reduced from 1.5 to 1 seconds
[*]Repair Kit (Relic): Added healing reduced from 10 to 2
[*]Changed attack pattern for secret Maw enemy
[*]Split sound effects and weapon sounds into separate audio settings
[*]Some Void Crystals were changed/rebalanced
[*]Added option to skip tutorial
[*]Completely overhauled tutorial
[*]Made some description changes in the Codex
[*]Completely overhauled has freezing works
[*]Upgrades are now colored appropriately so they are easier to see (Green text for increased
    stats and red for decreased stats)
[*]Improved visual appearance and clarity of relics
[*]Overhauled credits screen[/list][/i]

If you want to check out past devlogs, look at teasers for upcoming content, interact with the community, or hang out and ask questions about the game, make sure to join the [url=https://discord.gg/X4Qkm8aSs8]Void Knight Games discord[/url]

notes.title: Star Knight: Weekly Devlog 1
notes.content:
Welcome Star Knights!

After the huge success during Steam Next Fest with the Star Knight demo in October, I made a poll on my discord asking if people wanted weekly devlogs so they could keep up with development and see how progress was coming along. The answer was a resounding yes and since then I've made a post every Friday detailing what I worked on that week and adding sneak peeks at new content. However, I wanted people checking out the demo or following the game on Steam to also be able to see that steady progress in being made. So today I'll post last week's devlog and tomorrow I'll post the regular Friday devlog (If you want to see past devlogs, teasers for upcoming content, interact with the community, or hang out and ask questions about the game, make sure to join the [url=https://discord.gg/X4Qkm8aSs8]Void Knight Games Discord[/url] ).

Devlog for 01/05/2024:

[i]There has been a lot of progress this week, so this week's devlog is a thick one. I honestly accomplished a lot more than I thought I would and the game is in an actual good, playable state. Also, I figured out how to make rounded rectangles which look 1000% better than normal rectangles in my opinion.[/i]

[i][list]
[*]Added 4 new music tracks (2 new area and 2 new boss tracks)
[*]Frozen bosses have their speed and firerate reduced by 20% instead of being completely frozen
[*]All attachments now start with a 5 credit cost. More expensive attachments were rebalanced to   
  account for price change
[*]Fixed attachment spacing for the end game screen
[*]Added a boss cap to the debilitator (I thought I did this but I forgot :skull: )
[*]Massive graphics and UI overhaul to the pause menu
[*]Rebalanced crew member unlock requirements
[*]Improved credit attraction behavior
[*]First set of attachments of the run will always include at least 1 damage dealing attachment
[*]Made the Demon Realms much easier (I could barely beat it and if it's too hard me for its too   hard)
[*]Acid damage no longer ignores shields
[*]Rebalanced Void Crystals (they were way too hard)
[*]Rebalanced Arms Dealer effect
    - 2% damage per credit
    - 1% enemy damage per credit
[*]Rebalanced Projectile Disruptor Field relic
     - Projectiles that destroy enemy projectiles are now themselves destroyed
[*]Improved challenge level chance distribution
     - Min of 3 and max of 6 spread out across the run instead of min of 0 and ridiculous
    possible max of 12
[*]Defeating a boss now grants a relic
[*]Allied summons now have I-Frames
[*]Some Codex description changes
[*]Lots of other minor UI and graphical improvements
[*]So many other minor bug fixes (easily over 100)
[*]Numerous smaller tweaks and balance changes[/list][/i]

Hope you enjoyed the devlog and see you again [strike]next week[/strike] tomorrow!

-  Nick, Solo Dev for Star Knight: Order of the Vortex
